info.name: Warehouse API
info.description: Auto-generated from the Doctrine/API Platform entities in src/Entity (see СХЕМА-БД.md). Run "Register user" then "Login" first — every other request inherits the collection's Bearer token from {{accessToken}}. Requests are ordered so that running each folder's "Create" request top to bottom fills in the id variables the later folders depend on (categoryId -> productId -> clientId/supplierId -> receiptId -> batchId -> ...). Receipt/Sale/Writeoff no longer accept number/status/createdBy/receivedBy/totalUsd/totalUzs on create — the server generates the number and always starts in draft. Status only changes via the dedicated POST .../change_status endpoint (not PATCH). SaleItem no longer accepts batch/total/costPrice/costCurrency/costRate — the server picks batches via FIFO automatically and computes cost/total; price is optional and defaults to Product.priceUsd/priceUzs if omitted. StockMovement, SaleItemAllocation and Profit are read-only ledgers written only by the server when a document is posted/cancelled.

request.description: Creates the account used by every other request in this collection.
Stores accessToken/refreshToken as collection variables. The collection's Bearer auth reads {{accessToken}} automatically.
GET collection of Categories.
Creates a new Categories record and stores its id in {{categoryId}}.
rate_date is the primary key, so nothing needs to be captured from the response.
GET collection of Products.
Read-only report: every product with its current remaining quantity, aggregated from the stock_movements ledger (id, sku, name, unit, remainingQty).

Creates a new Products record and stores its id in {{productId}}. priceUsd/priceUzs are optional default sale prices (independently set, not derived from an exchange rate) — SaleItem.price falls back to these when omitted.
GET collection of Clients.
Creates a new Clients record and stores its id in {{clientId}}.
GET collection of Suppliers.
Creates a new Suppliers record and stores its id in {{supplierId}}.

request.description: GET collection of Receipts.

Creates a new Receipts record and stores its id in {{receiptId}}. number/status/receivedBy/totalUsd/totalUzs/createdAt are set by the server (auto number like ПР-00001, status always starts as draft, receivedBy = current user).

Only way to change status now (no generic PATCH on Receipt). draft->posted creates a Batch per item and writes an IN stock movement for each. posted->cancelled only works if none of the batches were used yet (deletes them and their movements). posted->draft is rejected.
GET collection of Batches. Batches are created by the server when a Receipt is posted — there is no client-facing create.
Copy an id from "List Batches" (or from the Receipt Items response after posting the Receipt) into {{batchId}}.
GET collection of Receipt Items.

Creates a new Receipt Items record and stores its id in {{receiptItemId}}. No batch/total in the body — batch is created by the server only once the Receipt is posted, total is computed from price*quantity. Fails with 422 if the Receipt is not in draft status or the product is already on this Receipt.
Only quantity/price/currency/rate are patchable. Fails with 422 once the parent Receipt is no longer draft.
Fails with 422 once the parent Receipt is no longer draft.
GET collection of Sales.

Creates a new Sales record and stores its id in {{saleId}}. number/status/soldBy/totalUsd/totalUzs/createdAt are set by the server (auto number like РН-00001, status always starts as draft). rate moved from Sale to SaleItem — see Sale Items.

Only way to change status now (no generic PATCH on Sale). draft->posted re-validates stock, writes an OUT stock movement and a realized Profit entry per allocation. posted->cancelled writes ADJUST/reversed entries with the opposite sign (nothing is deleted). posted->draft is rejected.
GET collection of Sale Items.

Creates a new Sale Items record and stores its id in {{saleItemId}}. No batch/total/costPrice/costCurrency/costRate in the body — the server picks batches automatically via FIFO (oldest receivedAt first, splitting across batches if needed) and computes cost/total; fails with 422 if stock across all batches of the product isn't enough. price is optional — if omitted, defaults to Product.priceUsd/priceUzs for the given currency (422 if neither was provided and the product has no default price). rate is the real UZS-per-USD exchange rate on the day of this sale line, always required regardless of currency — profit is reported in the batch's cost currency, so this rate is what converts revenue into that currency when it differs from the sale currency.
Only quantity/price/currency/rate are patchable. Changing quantity re-runs FIFO allocation from scratch. Fails with 422 once the parent Sale is no longer draft.
Fails with 422 once the parent Sale is no longer draft. Its allocations are cascade-deleted.

Read-only ledger written by the server when a Sale Item is created/updated. One Sale Item can have several allocations (one per batch it was FIFO-split across), each with its own costPrice/costCurrency/costRate.

item.name: Get Sale Item Allocations by id

request.description: Copy an id from "List Sale Item Allocations" (or from the Sale Items response) into {{saleItemAllocationId}}.
GET collection of Payments.
Creates a new Payments record and stores its id in {{paymentId}}.
GET collection of Payment Allocations.
Creates a new Payment Allocations record and stores its id in {{paymentAllocationId}}.
GET collection of Writeoffs.
Creates a new Writeoffs record and stores its id in {{writeoffId}}. number/status/createdBy/createdAt are set by the server (auto number like СП-00001, status always starts as draft).

Only way to change status now (no generic PATCH on Writeoff). draft->posted re-validates stock and writes a WRITEOFF stock movement per item. posted->cancelled writes ADJUST/reversed movements with the opposite sign. posted->draft is rejected.
GET collection of Writeoff Items.

Creates a new Writeoff Items record and stores its id in {{writeoffItemId}}. Unlike Sale Items, batch is still picked manually here — no FIFO auto-allocation for writeoffs. Fails with 422 if the Writeoff is not draft or this batch is already on it.
Fails with 422 once the parent Writeoff is no longer draft.
Fails with 422 once the parent Writeoff is no longer draft.

Read-only ledger — no Post/Patch/Delete anymore. Entries are written by the server when Receipts/Sales/Writeoffs are posted (type=in/out/writeoff) or cancelled (type=adjust, reversing entry with the opposite sign). Remaining quantity for a batch/product is SUM(quantity) over this table.
Copy an id from "List Stock Movements" into {{stockMovementId}}.

Read-only profit ledger — no Post/Patch/Delete. One "realized" entry per Sale Item Allocation is written when a Sale is posted (revenue - cost, reported in the batch's cost currency — revenue is converted into that currency via the sale item's rate when it differs); posting below cost yields a negative realized entry (a real loss, not a reversal). Cancelling a posted Sale writes a "reversed" entry with the opposite sign — nothing is ever mutated or deleted, so SUM(profit) WHERE sale=X always reflects the current truth.
Copy an id from "List Profits" into {{profitId}}.
